name: [PART 2!🎆] Fight The Monsters: Revamped
desc:
FIXED FIGHT THE MONSTERS (FTM)
GAMEPASSES ARE TRANSFERRED.

In FIGHT THE MONSTERS! Battle dangerous creatures across a vast world. Collect and use 800+ weapons and face massive megabosses that test your strength.

New Content:

~Summary~
This week's update is focused on making the game easier for casual players 
while still helping the veterans! Features such as the Abyssal Market, 
increased damage bonuses, and rebalanced enemy scaling all combine to 
make the game more enjoyable, with more long-term goals and incentives 
brought by the Abyssal Market! Also brought along is a series of quality-of-life 
changes that should make the game better and an opportunity to get a head 
start in the Halloween Event!
